authentication.mode: direct implementation using the Web Crypto API
authentication.username_policy: 4-40 chars: lowercase a-z, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; uppercase is rejected, not normalized
authentication.session_db_storage: SHA-256 hash of the opaque session token
authentication.cookie: HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict; Secure on HTTPS; Path=/

ownership.rule: plans are selected by authenticated user_id; tasks, logs, revisions, reflections and carryovers inherit ownership through plan relations
ownership.foreign_resource_response: 404 NOT_FOUND to hide whether another user's resource exists
ownership.client_user_id_trust: none; query/header/body user identifiers never choose the owner

usage_study_config.purpose: T07 day-1 fixed question, metric, unit, calculation and data handling rules

usage_daily_records.purpose: exactly one record per actual Asia/Seoul date, maximum five

plan_rule_changes.purpose: one rule change after day 2 and before day 3

five_day_rules.date_source: server-computed current date in Asia/Seoul; client cannot choose the date
five_day_rules.day3_gate: when exactly two records exist and no plan_rule_changes row exists, the next daily record is rejected
five_day_rules.duplicate: second record for the same Asia/Seoul date is rejected and the existing record remains
five_day_rules.missing: missing dates are not filled with zero; the study remains incomplete
five_day_rules.summary: sum of all stored metric values; average = sum / record count; rounded using rounding_digits

legacy_migration.rule: when the first account is registered, all existing T06 plans whose user_id is NULL are assigned to that first account
legacy_migration.reason: preserve the final T06 diary data while adding T07 authentication

export.scope: only data owned by the authenticated account
